 Sun TV Network: Declares Interim Dividend, Re-appoints Key Directors 
 Company Results 
 2 min read 
 Sun TV Network Limited’s Board of Directors convened on October 30, 2026 , approving the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 . The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs. 3.75 per equity share . Key re-appointments include Mr. Kalanithi Maran as Executive Chairman and Mrs. Kavery Kalanithi as Executive Director, both for a five-year term commencing April 20, 2027.
 Board Approves Financial Results and Dividend
 The Board of Directors of Sun TV Network Limited met on October 30, 2026 , and approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 . Alongside the financial disclosures, the Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 3.75 per equity share of Rs. 5/- each, representing 75% for the financial year 2026-27.
 Key Leadership Appointments
 The Nomination & Remuneration Committee’s recommendations were accepted by the Board for the re-appointment of two key executives. Mr. Kalanithi Maran (DIN: 00113886) has been re-appointed as a Whole Time Director, designated as “Executive Chairman” . This re-appointment is for a period of five years, effective from April 20, 2027, to April 19, 2032 , subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
 Similarly, Mrs. Kavery Kalanithi (DIN: 00113905) has been re-appointed as a Whole Time Director, designated as “Executive Director” , also for a five-year term from April 20, 2027, to April 19, 2032 . This re-appointment is also subject to shareholder approval through a postal ballot.
 Financial Highlights (Unaudited, Six Months Ended September 30, 2026) 
 Standalone Financials
 Revenues from Operations: Rs. 2,225.15 crores
 Total Income: Rs. 2,525.02 crores
 Profit Before Tax: Rs. 1,245.33 crores
 Profit After Tax: Rs. 953.84 crores
 Earnings Per Share (Basic and Diluted): Rs. 24.20
 Consolidated Financials
 Revenues from Operations: Rs. 2,712.98 crores
 Total Income: Rs. 2,712.98 crores
 Profit Before Tax: Rs. 1,284.43 crores
 Profit After Tax: Rs. 983.66 crores
 Earnings Per Share (Basic and Diluted): Rs. 24.96
 The unaudited financial results will be made available on the company’s website at https://www.suntv.in/ .
